conflictReviewHint: Compare the disk version with your draft below. Edit your draft to merge the changes, then save the reviewed result. The disk version will be checked again.
configurationReview: This plugin proposed these changes. Review the fields and save to apply them. Nothing has been saved yet.
configurationMigrationHint: Review renamed settings in this scope. Applying moves compatible old values to empty new fields. Existing or incompatible values are preserved. Save or reload pending edits first.

configurationMigrationStatus.incompatible: Value or scope incompatible; kept unchanged

configurationHint: Configure plugin parameters here. Credentials are not supported in ordinary settings. Configuration does not grant extra permissions.
configurationIssues: Some saved fields are incompatible and have been ignored. Stored data is retained:
configurationInvalid: A value does not match the declared type or bounds.
configurationConflict: Configuration changed elsewhere. Your edits are kept. Reload the configuration before trying again.
documentConflict: The file changed on disk. Your draft is kept; saving was blocked. Review the differences below. If the file is unavailable, copy your draft before reopening it.
defaultViewer: Use by default for this file type
viewerDirty: Save or discard changes before switching viewers.
viewerFallback: Plugin viewer unavailable. Using the built-in viewer.
hostBoundary: Local plugins use declared permissions. Background tasks and external requests are supervised by the host.
title: Local plugins
subtitle: Manage local plugin sources, permissions and entries
developmentHint: Run local plugins after reviewing their permissions. Turning this off disables all local plugins.
grantHint: Enable grants all listed permissions within the selected projects. Application views cannot read project files.
uninstallHint: Uninstall removes plugin resources and entries. Private data is retained; linked source files are retained.
deleteHint: Permanently delete this plugin's private data? Active plugin pages will be closed.
themeHint: After authorization, choose these palettes in Appearance. Settings and approvals retain built-in colors; the palette applies when they close. Unavailable plugins fall back to the built-in theme. Theme selection is application-wide; plugin configuration keeps its existing scopes. No CSS or scripts are loaded.
windowHint: Windows use the same isolated plugin permissions. Closing discards page-local edits; saved private data and background tasks follow their existing rules. Reopening restores window position and size, not unsaved content. Project windows close on project or worktree changes. Plugin content is hidden while host dialogs or approvals are open.
contextHint: The built-in Agent can read these saved project files on demand after authorization. Reads are limited to 32 KiB and return untrusted data; unsaved editor drafts are excluded. Disabling stops future reads but cannot erase text already read into a conversation.
workflowHint: Review every service and its input mapping. Agent approval covers the whole sequence, including external effects. A failed or stopped step prevents later steps; completed effects are not undone. No automatic retries.
skillHint: Skills supply third-party guidance to the built-in Agent. Reading a skill does not run its services or grant extra access. Service calls still follow host approval. Review this text before enabling; disabling the plugin stops future reads, but cannot erase content already read into a conversation.
modelHint: Model tasks send their input to your default Janus model and may incur charges. Up to 2 requests per minute per plugin, with at most 1,024 output tokens per request. Disabling the plugin stops new requests.
backgroundHint: Tasks continue after closing their page. Switching projects stops project tasks. Stop tasks here; retry by running again. History is kept for this app session.
